# Pixel-art fixtures

These unmodified PNGs were created by SpriteCook, who states that all assets in the repository are released under [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). SpriteCook states that the assets were made with AI assistance. Attribution is not required, but is provided here to make the test corpus traceable.

Source: [SpriteCook Free Game Assets](https://github.com/SpriteCook/spritecook-free-game-assets), commit `cd0db67d6f849c8d84e406a436aac76b733a7dba`.

| Fixture | Original file | Size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sword.png | [examples/inventory-icons/sword.png](https://github.com/SpriteCook/spritecook-free-game-assets/blob/cd0db67d6f849c8d84e406a436aac76b733a7dba/examples/inventory-icons/sword.png) | 21 × 21 |
| potion.png | [examples/inventory-icons/health_potion.png](https://github.com/SpriteCook/spritecook-free-game-assets/blob/cd0db67d6f849c8d84e406a436aac76b733a7dba/examples/inventory-icons/health_potion.png) | 15 × 21 |
| shield.png | [examples/inventory-icons/shield.png](https://github.com/SpriteCook/spritecook-free-game-assets/blob/cd0db67d6f849c8d84e406a436aac76b733a7dba/examples/inventory-icons/shield.png) | 17 × 21 |
| tiny-wizard.png | [examples/tiny-pixel-art/tiny_wiz.png](https://github.com/SpriteCook/spritecook-free-game-assets/blob/cd0db67d6f849c8d84e406a436aac76b733a7dba/examples/tiny-pixel-art/tiny_wiz.png) | 32 × 32 |
| owl-sheet.png | [examples/tiny-pixel-art/tiny_owl_idle_spritesheet.png](https://github.com/SpriteCook/spritecook-free-game-assets/blob/cd0db67d6f849c8d84e406a436aac76b733a7dba/examples/tiny-pixel-art/tiny_owl_idle_spritesheet.png) | 224 × 28 |

The first four are individual transparent images; the last is a sprite sheet and should be treated as a separate scenario. This small corpus does not represent all pixel-art styles.
